coverage_notes.note: The acceptance-by-clicking, using, or distributing provision on line 16 makes the Agreement binding, but does not itself state a specific activity permission or prohibition that can be faithfully represented using the supplied activity modalities; its binding-effect mechanism is identified as unresolved in paragraph audit.
The incorporated Acceptable Use Policy and brand guidelines are external documents not supplied in full; their contents are not inferred.

Section 5(c)'s indemnification is a standalone duty with no faithful activity in the permitted activity vocabulary; it is recorded as a proxy clause and must be treated as unrepresentable operative material.
Section 2's license-request duty is captured as a factual obligation; the supplied activities do not include requesting a license.
No cure period is stated for breach termination. The Section 6 survival sentence identifies Sections 3, 4, and 7; it does not create an activity constraint.

The supplied text says the Policy applies if a person accesses or uses Meta Llama 3 and points to a most recent copy at an external URL. The contents of any later version are not supplied and are not inferred.

Lines 80–84 request reporting specified issues through listed channels. Reporting is operative request language, but no allowed activity represents reporting; this remains unresolved rather than being mapped to an inaccurate activity.

      		iii. Human trafficking, exploitation, and sexual violence
      		iv. The illegal distribution of information or materials to minors, including obscene materials, or failure to employ legally required age-gating in connection with such information or materials.
      		v. Sexual solicitation
      		vi. Any other criminal activity
   	b. Engage in, promote, incite, or facilitate the harassment, abuse, threatening, or bullying of individuals or groups of individuals
   	c. Engage in, promote, incite, or facilitate discrimination or other unlawful or harmful conduct in the provision of employment, employment benefits, credit, housing, other economic benefits, or other essential goods and services
   	d. Engage in the unauthorized or unlicensed practice of any profession including, but not limited to, financial, legal, medical/health, or related professional practices
   	e. Collect, process, disclose, generate, or infer health, demographic, or other sensitive personal or private information about individuals without rights and consents required by applicable laws
   	f. Engage in or facilitate any action or generate any content that infringes, misappropriates, or otherwise violates any third-party rights, including the outputs or results of any products or services using the Llama Materials
   	g. Create, generate, or facilitate the creation of malicious code, malware, computer viruses or do anything else that could disable, overburden, interfere with or impair the proper working, integrity, operation or appearance of a website or computer system
rules.scope_note: Acceptable Use Policy, lines 47–61: prohibits using, or allowing others to use, Meta Llama 3 for the listed conduct. The rights-violation category expressly includes outputs or results of products or services using Llama Materials. The sensitive-information restriction applies only without rights and consents required by applicable laws; the professional-practice restriction applies to unauthorized or unlicensed practice.
rules.condition_explanation: licensee_accesses_or_uses_meta_llama_3 means the licensee accesses or uses Meta Llama 3, the applicability stated at line 45. The categories in requires are alternatives. The sensitive-information category covers collecting, processing, disclosing, generating, or inferring health, demographic, or other sensitive personal or private information without legally required rights and consents. The listed professional practices include financial, legal, medical/health, and related practices. Malicious-code or impairment conduct includes creating, generating, or facilitating malicious code, malware, or computer viruses, or otherwise impairing the proper working, integrity, operation, or appearance of a website or computer system.

obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee accesses or uses Meta Llama 3 and the use engages in, promotes, facilitates, or otherwise involves a listed prohibited category; sensitive-information handling is covered only absent legally required rights and consents, and professional practice is covered when unauthorized or unlicensed.
